052/**
053 * Robot Class
054 *
055 * <p>This is the main class for robot code, instantiated in {@link com.stuypulse.robot.Main} It
056 * extends TimedRobot, meaning that the methods in this class are called automatically during
057 * specific states of the robot.
058 */
059public class Robot extends LoggedOpModeRobot {
060    private static final Alert allianceMissing =
061            new Alert(
062                    "MissingAllianceWarning",
063                    "Alliance optional has no value present",
064                    Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
065
066    /**
067     * Checks the alliance the robot is on
068     *
069     * @return true if the robot is on the blue alliance, false if the robot is on the red alliance,
070     *     and false if alliance cannot be determined.
071     */
072    public static boolean isBlue() {
073        final Optional<Alliance> alliance = MatchState.getAlliance();
074        if (alliance.isPresent()) {
075            allianceMissing.set(false);
076            return alliance.get() == Alliance.BLUE;
077        } else {
078            allianceMissing.set(true);
079        }
080        return false;
081    }
082
083    // Gamepads
084    public final CommandGamepad driver =
085            new CommandGamepad(DriverConstants.Driver.DRIVER_INDEX); // model-agnostic controller
086    public final Swerve swerve;
087    public final Vision vision;
088    public final Scheduler defaultScheduler;
089
090    public Robot() {
091        this.defaultScheduler = Scheduler.getDefault();
092        configureLogging();
093
094        EnumMap<Camera, VisionIO> visionIOMap = new EnumMap<>(Camera.class);
095        switch (GlobalSettings.CURRENT_MODE) {
096            case REAL -> {
097                swerve =
098                        new Swerve(
099                                new GyroIOPigeon2(),
100                                new ModuleIOTalonFX(TunerConstants.FrontLeft),
101                                new ModuleIOTalonFX(TunerConstants.FrontRight),
102                                new ModuleIOTalonFX(TunerConstants.BackLeft),
103                                new ModuleIOTalonFX(TunerConstants.BackRight));
104                for (Camera camera : VisionConstants.Camera.values()) {
105                    visionIOMap.put(
106                            camera,
107                            VisionConstants.VISION_MODE == VisionMode.LIMELIGHT
108                                    ? new VisionIOLimelight(
109                                            camera.getName(),
110                                            camera.getRobotToCamera(),
111                                            swerve::getRotation)
112                                    : new VisionIOPhoton(
113                                            camera.getName(), camera.getRobotToCamera()));
114                }
115            }
116
117            case SIM -> {
118                swerve =
119                        new Swerve(
120                                new GyroIO() {},
121                                new ModuleIOSim(TunerConstants.FrontLeft),
122                                new ModuleIOSim(TunerConstants.FrontRight),
123                                new ModuleIOSim(TunerConstants.BackLeft),
124                                new ModuleIOSim(TunerConstants.BackRight));
125                for (Camera camera : Camera.values()) {
126                    visionIOMap.put(
127                            camera,
128                            new VisionIOPhotonSim(
129                                    camera.getName(), camera.getRobotToCamera(), swerve::getPose));
130                }
131            }
132
133            default -> {
134                swerve =
135                        new Swerve(
136                                new GyroIO() {},
137                                new ModuleIO() {},
138                                new ModuleIO() {},
139                                new ModuleIO() {},
140                                new ModuleIO() {});
141                for (Camera camera : Camera.values()) {
142                    visionIOMap.put(camera, new VisionIO() {});
143                }
144            }
145        }
146        vision = new Vision(swerve.visionConsumer, visionIOMap);
147
148        configureDefaultCommands();
149        configureButtonBindings();
150        configureAutons();
151        configureSysIds();
152        publishOpModes();
153    }
154
155    /*********************/
156    /*** CONFIGURATION ***/
157    /*********************/
158
159    private void configureLogging() {
160        // Git metadata
161        Logger.recordMetadata("ProjectName", BuildConstants.MAVEN_NAME);
162        Logger.recordMetadata("BuildDate", BuildConstants.BUILD_DATE);
163        Logger.recordMetadata("GitCommitMessage", BuildConstants.GIT_MESSAGE);
164        if (!BuildConstants.GIT_LINK.isBlank()) {
165            Logger.recordMetadata("GitCommitLink", BuildConstants.GIT_LINK);
166        }
167        Logger.recordMetadata(
168                "GitPushStatus",
169                switch (BuildConstants.GIT_PUSH_STATUS) {
170                    case "PUSHED" -> "Commit pushed to remote repository";
171                    case "NOT_PUSHED" -> "Local commit not pushed to remote repository";
172                    case "STALE" -> "Could not verify push status. Cached information may be stale";
173                    default -> "Unable to determine commit push status";
174                });
175        Logger.recordMetadata("GitSHA", BuildConstants.GIT_SHA);
176        Logger.recordMetadata("GitDate", BuildConstants.GIT_DATE);
177        Logger.recordMetadata("GitBranch", BuildConstants.GIT_BRANCH);
178        Logger.recordMetadata(
179                "GitDirty",
180                switch (BuildConstants.DIRTY) {
181                    case 0 -> "All changes committed";
182                    case 1 -> "Uncommitted changes";
183                    default -> "Unknown";
184                });
185
186        // Log setup
187        switch (GlobalSettings.CURRENT_MODE) {
188            case REAL -> {
189                // Running on a real robot, log to a USB stick ("/U/logs")
190                Logger.addDataReceiver(new WPILOGWriter());
191                Logger.addDataReceiver(new NT4Publisher());
192            }
193
194            case SIM -> {
195                // Running a physics simulator, log to NT
196                Logger.addDataReceiver(new NT4Publisher());
197            }
198
199            case REPLAY -> {
200                // Replaying a log, set up replay source
201                setUseTiming(false); // Run as fast as possible
202                String logPath = LogFileUtil.findReplayLog();
203                Logger.setReplaySource(new WPILOGReader(logPath));
204                Logger.addDataReceiver(
205                        new WPILOGWriter(LogFileUtil.addPathSuffix(logPath, "_replay")));
206            }
207        }
208
209        Logger.start();
210        Tunables.publish("Field", FieldConstants.FIELD_2D);
211    }
212
213    private void configureDefaultCommands() {
214        swerve.setDefaultCommand(DriveCommands.joystickDrive(swerve, driver));
215    }
216
217    private void configureButtonBindings() {
218        driver.dpadUp().onTrue(DriveCommands.resetHeading(swerve, Rotation2d.ZERO));
219    }
220
221    private void configureAutons() {
222        AutonFactory autonFactory = new AutonFactory(swerve, vision);
223
224        AutonOpMode.addDefaultAuton("Do Nothing", autonFactory.doNothingAuton());
225
226        addOpMode(RobotMode.AUTONOMOUS, "Chooser Auton", () -> new AutonOpMode(this));
227    }
228
229    private void configureSysIds() {
230        addOpMode(
231                RobotMode.UTILITY,
232                "Quasistatic Reverse",
233                "SysId",
234                () -> new SwerveDriveSysId(swerve, Direction.REVERSE, SysIdRoutine::quasistatic));
235        addOpMode(
236                RobotMode.UTILITY,
237                "Quasistatic Forward",
238                "SysId",
239                () -> new SwerveDriveSysId(swerve, Direction.FORWARD, SysIdRoutine::quasistatic));
240        addOpMode(
241                RobotMode.UTILITY,
242                "Dynamic Forward",
243                "SysId",
244                () -> new SwerveDriveSysId(swerve, Direction.FORWARD, SysIdRoutine::dynamic));
245        addOpMode(
246                RobotMode.UTILITY,
247                "Dynamic Reverse",
248                "SysId",
249                () -> new SwerveDriveSysId(swerve, Direction.REVERSE, SysIdRoutine::dynamic));
250    }
251
252    /************************/
253    /*** ROBOT SCHEDULING ***/
254    /************************/
255
256    @Override
257    public void robotPeriodic() {
258        defaultScheduler.run();
259        PeriodicSubsystem.runAllPeriodicAfterScheduler();
260    }
261}
